description.zh: 阿里云容器服务Kubernetes版的Kubernetes集群的ID。
description.en: The ID of the ASK cluster.
The name of the cluster. This parameter is required if the ClusterType parameter is set to ecs.

The cluster type.

Valid values:

*   ecs: ECS
*   one: ACK One
*   ask: ASK
*   pro: Container Monitoring Pro

description.zh: 集群绑定的托管版Grafana工作区Id。为空或"free"时，绑定到共享版Grafana。
description.en: The ID of the managed Grafana workspace that is associated with the cluster. If you set this parameter to free or leave this parameter empty, the cluster is associated with a shared Grafana workspace.
Resource group ID of the Prometheus instance.
The ID of the security group to which the cluster belongs.
The ID of the vSwitch that is used by the cluster.
Extension information for the Flink VC cluster.
The virtual private cloud (VPC) where the cluster resides.

descriptions.zh: 只适用于ASK和ECS实例，且集群未安装过阿里云Prometheus，托管Prometheus将被安装在云产品侧，用户集群中不可见。
descriptions.en: This applies only to ASK and ECS instances, and only if Alibaba Cloud Prometheus has not been previously installed on the cluster. The managed Prometheus instance will be installed on the cloud service side and will not be visible within the user's cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms install-managed-prometheus --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxyexli20000 --cluster-name prd-ecs --cluster-type ask --vpc-id vpc-xxxxxx --vswitch-id vsw-bp1000000000 --security-group-id sg-bp100000000 --grafana-instance-id grafana-bp100000 --kube-config - --vc-extra-info - --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms InstallManagedPrometheus --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxyexli20000' --VpcId 'vpc-xxxxxx' --ClusterId cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --VSwitchId 'vsw-bp1000000000' --SecurityGroupId 'sg-bp100000000' --KubeConfig '-' --ClusterName 'prd-ecs' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClusterType ask --GrafanaInstanceId 'grafana-bp100000' --VcExtraInfo '-'
